parts.Pivot: Four Kraken X60s tilt the whole elevator at its base, from lying flat (0°) to upright (90°). There's no absolute encoder, so the robot must be turned on with the pivot upright.
parts.Elevator: Two Kraken X60s drive a 2-stage continuous elevator, 0.91 m of carriage travel. It must be fully down at power-on (or homed with the Home command).
parts.Wrist: Two Kraken X44s through ThriftyBot cycloidals turn the end effector on the carriage. Its angle is measured from the elevator, so the end effector's angle from the floor is pivot + wrist.
parts.Superstructure: The driver picks a goal (A stow, RB coral intake, LB/B/X/Y = L1-L4). The Motion machine gets there safely: a pivot move of more than 5° first pulls the elevator in below 0.15 m, then swings the pivot, then extends.
parts.Drivetrain: Four-module Kraken X60 swerve (5.90:1, 2 in wheels; module constants still the offseason robot's until Tuner X regenerates them). Left stick drives field-centric, right stick turns, Start resets the heading. With the elevator up the driver is slowed (down to 35% at full height) because the robot is tall and top-heavy.
